stories.h: Godzilla Minus Zero and Ramayana lead global weekend
stories.why: Asian cinema owning the global top two
sum: The Japanese monster sequel Godzilla Minus Zero topped the worldwide chart with an estimated $63m, and its North American debut is reported as the biggest ever for a live-action foreign-language release.

India's Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend followed with $52.2m, helped by Diwali. Warner's animated The Cat In The Hat opened third on $30.5m. Wild Horse Nine and a Stray Kids concert film also opened. All figures are estimates.
pts: Godzilla Minus Zero: $63m worldwide
Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend: $52.2m
The Cat In The Hat opens third at $30.5m

stories.h: Fjord: Mungiu's Norway drama draws a savage verdict
stories.why: A big-name festival-circuit film to skip or argue about
sum: Cristian Mungiu's Fjord stars Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve as parents in a religious immigrant family on the Norwegian coast, whose strict child-rearing attracts the attention of state child services.

Little White Lies' David Jenkins finds the tone overheated and lopsided, more keen to watch the family suffer than to weigh the facts. He calls the leads flat where intensity is needed, and finds a neighbour subplot baffling. Despite respect for Mungiu, he thinks it misfires badly.
pts: Mungiu directs; Stan and Reinsve star
Critic finds it one-sided and overwrought
Scores: Anticipation 4, Enjoyment 1, In Retrospect 1

stories.h: Being Heumann: warm but conventional disability-rights biopic
sum: Being Heumann follows disability rights activist Judy Heumann and her late-1970s fight for federal protections for disabled Americans. Ruth Madeley plays her, with Dylan O'Brien and Mark Ruffalo in the cast.

Little White Lies calls it likeable and well-meaning, in the mould of a nineties feelgood drama. The ensemble shines and disabled actors get room to work, but the storytelling is routine and the politics feel muted, leaving the critic wanting more substance.
pts: Ruth Madeley leads with charisma
Pleasant but superficial, per the review
Scores: 3 / 3 / 3

stories.h: Nothing new from Beyoncé or Kendrick Lamar today
sum: No releases, tour dates, features or announcements in the last 24 hours.

stories.h: Blackhaine's debut Saints in the Wethouse is a bruised, bleak triumph
stories.why: Dark, experimental edge beyond standard indie
sum: The Line of Best Fit gives Blackhaine's first album a 9/10. It sets rain-soaked streets, police lights and a drug haze to industrial and club textures, futuristic rap and drifting ambient passages.

The reviewer likens the mood to Northern noir fiction. The record builds toward a more rapturous second half, with "Spirit" the high point, then ends in harsh noise that drops the listener back into the grim reality.
pts: Scored 9/10 by The Line of Best Fit
Industrial, club and rap textures
"Spirit" is the standout track

stories.h: yeule announces EP a+e and shares dance-pop single Lovepill
sum: yeule will put out a new EP, a+e, on December 4 through Warner Records. It is framed as a futuristic, cyborg-flavoured romance.

The new single "Lovepill" was co-written and produced with pop producers including Frank Dukes. Stereogum hears a deadpan, electroclash-leaning dance-pop track, following the earlier single "Hystérique".
pts: EP a+e arrives December 4 on Warner
Single "Lovepill" out now
Co-produced with Frank Dukes and others

stories.h: 54 Ultra and Clairo team up on Honeymoon
sum: New Jersey artist 54 Ultra has released "Honeymoon", produced and co-written by Clairo. It leans on smoky late-1970s pop.
It was recorded to analog tape at Electric Lady Studios using mostly vintage gear, including a Yamaha CP70 piano. The article also lists tour dates across the US, Europe and Australia.
pts: Clairo produced and co-wrote it
Tracked to tape at Electric Lady
Tour dates in US, Europe, Australia

stories.h: Zsela announces second album The Party, shares Real Romantic
sum: Zsela, the Brooklyn-born, LA-based artist, will release her second album The Party on February 19 via Nice Life. Her debut Big For You came out in 2024.
The nine-track record sounds like breezy soul-pop with a modern take on 1980s adult-contemporary. She made it with co-producer Zack Sekoff, largely in a makeshift studio, and plays LA on November 19.
pts: The Party due February 19, 2027
Nine tracks, single "Real Romantic" out
LA show on November 19

stories.h: Avhath's self-titled debut lands after 14 years
sum: Pophariini's reviewer praises the Indonesian band's first full-length, arriving 14 years after they formed. He credits years of growth in songwriting, production and promotion.
The album mixes their early style with fresher arrangements and heavier death metal riffs. Guitarist Rey produced it, and the closer "Cinereal Gaze" is the reviewer's favourite.
pts: First full album after 14 years
Death metal riffs add weight
Guitarist Rey produced it

stories.h: Melissa x Powerpuff Girls blind boxes and candy sandals
stories.why: Whimsical, colorful and a little cartoon-weird
sum: Brazilian jelly-shoe label Melissa has teamed up with The Powerpuff Girls for its first blind box line. Collectible mini figures of Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup are made from the brand's vegan PVC and smell of tutti-frutti, with a rare villain chase figure hidden among them.

On the wearable side there is a low kitten-heel thong sandal in sugary tones for adults, plus two kids' styles. It is on sale now through Melissa's site, and a blind box installation is up at its Sao Paulo flagship.
pts: Blind box figures with a rare H.I.M. chase piece
Kitten Heel thong sandal in candy colors
Available now on shopmelissa.com

stories.h: ASICS GEL-1130 gets HERALBONY art treatment
stories.why: Colorful, niche and hand-drawn sneaker energy
sum: ASICS SportStyle and Japanese art label HERALBONY have reworked the retro GEL-1130 on a cream base, covered in dense artwork of tiny figures by artist Michiko Koyama. The upper has a paper-like texture, and the weave was tuned to look like pen strokes.
Teal, red and orange accents run across the toe, laces, sides and heel. It launched 13 November at 19,800 yen (about 124 USD) via ASICS online, a Tokyo pop-up and Notre in Chicago.
pts: Cream base with teal, red and orange accents
Launched 13 Nov, about 124 USD
Even the shoebox carries the artwork

stories.h: Crocs x Pokemon: Pikachu, Gengar, Jigglypuff clogs
sum: To mark Pokemon's 30th anniversary, Crocs is releasing three clogs. Pikachu gets a yellow Classic Clog, Gengar a deep purple one, and Jigglypuff a pastel pink Classic Platform Clog.
They go on sale 17 November on the Crocs website, at 13,200 yen for the first two and 13,750 yen for the platform. A fun pick for adding Jibbitz and playful color to a casual look.
pts: Yellow, purple and pastel pink options
Release 17 Nov via Crocs online
Platform version for Jigglypuff

stories.h: Vans x Pringle of Scotland puts argyle wool on skate shoes
sum: Vans and Pringle of Scotland swap canvas for brushed, felted argyle wool on three classics: the Authentic 44, Sk8-Hi Reissue 38 and Classic Slip-On 98.

One colorway mixes navy, burgundy, olive and sage with a checkered toe panel, and another pairs black and white with blush-pink diamonds. All have white sidewalls. Prices run 110 to 130 USD, and they are available now on vans.com.
pts: Navy, burgundy, olive, sage and blush-pink argyle
Authentic, Sk8-Hi and Slip-On
110 to 130 USD, available now

stories.h: VEJA and Marimekko drop pink-red floral sneakers
stories.why: Colorful, whimsical print on a niche-leaning sneaker
sum: VEJA and Finnish design house Marimekko have released a limited sneaker capsule in the Popkorni print, a pink and red floral originally made by paper cutting. It comes as the adult Salar and the kids' Small Canary.

The Salar mixes suede and traced leather panels over a recycled-polyester mesh upper with a Vibram sole. Both pairs use sugarcane-based midsoles and Amazonian rubber outsoles. Available now on VEJA's site and at select stores.
pts: Popkorni floral print in pink and red
Salar for adults, Small Canary for kids
Recycled mesh and bio-based midsole

stories.h: Reebok x Tobe Nwigwe adds laceless Chukwu ATO and ANO
stories.why: Mint and salmon colors on a niche collab shoe
sum: Reebok and artist Tobe Nwigwe continue their Chukwu line with two new shoes. The ATO is their first laceless sneaker, and the ANO blends Nwigwe's style with classic Reebok design.
The ATO comes in his signature mint and in black, while the ANO arrives in black and gum and a salmon and black mix. The pairs are available now on Reebok's site and select retailers.
pts: Chukwu ATO is the first laceless pair
Mint and salmon colorways stand out
Available now at Reebok

stories.h: Tyler, the Creator and Converse add a low Bronco Boot
sum: Tyler, the Creator's GOLF le FLEUR* and Converse have widened their 1908 footwear line with three retro-inspired shoes. The headline is the Bronco Boot Low, a suede and leather lug-soled take on Converse's 1990s sneaker-boot hybrid, in Cocoa Brown, New Wheat, Eden and Black.
Also back are a chunky-lace Pro Leather and a nylon and hairy-suede Jogger in High Risk Red and Golden Haze. All are available now.
pts: Bronco Boot Low in four colors
Jogger in red and golden yellow
On sale at Converse and GOLF le FLEUR*

stories.h: NOCTA x Nike Air Modmax gets a pink gradient
stories.why: Loud pink sneaker with a futuristic look
sum: New images show Drake's NOCTA x Nike Air Modmax in the Pink Spell colorway, the debut of Nike's new Air Modmax tech. The upper fades through pink, with volt, amarillo and cobalt tint touches and three translucent amber pods at the heel.
It is slated for the end of 2026 at 180 USD through Nike. The article's color list looks a bit muddled, so treat the exact palette as unconfirmed.
pts: Pink gradient upper with amber heel pods
180 USD, holiday 2026
Nike's new Air Modmax cushioning

stories.h: Eastern Indonesia coalition demands halt to nickel and coal expansion
sum: Ahead of COP31, a coalition of Indigenous groups, women, youth, academics and journalists from Sulawesi, Maluku, Papua and Nusa Tenggara urged Jakarta to protect customary territories and stop extractive expansion in the east.

They point to captive coal capacity in Central Sulawesi rising from 2.96 GW to 7.33 GW in two years, and say 99 of 411 nickel concessions overlap key biodiversity areas. Their demands include revoking Presidential Regulation 112/2022, publishing a retirement roadmap for captive coal plants, independent audits, and protection for environmental defenders.
pts: Coalition cites about 81,000 respiratory infection cases in Morowali in 2025
Calls for no new mining permits in biodiversity areas and Indigenous lands
Says a transition ignoring human rights is not a real transition

stories.h: Gibran's diploma crisis edges toward resignation or impeachment
stories.why: DPR, dynasty politics and rule of law
sum: An analysis by a BRIN researcher traces the vice president's diploma dispute. The Constitutional Court dismissed a challenge on standing on 6 October, and the Supreme Court annulled his high school equivalency certificate on 30 October.

Per the article, Gibran reportedly told President Prabowo on 10 November that he intended to resign while seeking to prove his documents legally. DPR leaders confirmed lawmakers are gathering signatures for an impeachment inquiry. The author notes impeachment needs a two-thirds DPR vote plus court review, so it would be slow.
pts: Court rulings have undermined the legitimacy of his candidacy papers
Impeachment inquiry signatures are circulating in the DPR
Author argues public trust and equal treatment under law are at stake

stories.h: Hypothermia death of infant and hospital strike deepen Gaza winter crisis
sum: AFP, citing medical sources, reported that a nine-month-old boy died of hypothermia in a tent in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, as heavy rain flooded shelters. Aid restrictions continue, according to Middle East Eye.

Health officials said 11 people were killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza on Thursday. Two drones struck Nasser Hospital's surgical department the previous day, killing six people including a surgeon and a child, and wounding about 30. Medical Aid for Palestine says surgical services there are suspended.
pts: At least 1,614 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 ceasefire, per cited health figures
Nasser Hospital surgical unit out of service after drone strike
Flooded tents and aid limits worsen conditions for displaced families

stories.h: Israeli attacks kill at least eight in Gaza as storm floods tent camps
sum: Local health sources told Al Jazeera and Reuters that Israeli forces killed at least eight Palestinians across Gaza, including a father and his 13-year-old son. Three died in an air attack on a family home in Gaza City.

Gaza's Government Media Office says a storm flooded about 70,000 tents in 12 hours, and accuses Israel of blocking tents and mobile homes. Negotiators have still not agreed terms on Hamas disarmament or Israeli withdrawal, and Israel controls about two-thirds of the territory.
pts: Health Ministry says over 1,600 killed since the truce began
Roughly 85 percent of homes damaged or destroyed, per the article
Aid entry remains restricted

stories.h: 14-year-old killed in West Bank raid as settler violence climbs
sum: Israeli forces shot dead Moataz Iyad Daghlas, 14, during a raid on Burqa near Nablus, and wounded two other teenagers, Al Jazeera reports. The Israeli military said soldiers fired to stop stone-throwing at vehicles.

Wafa reported soldiers detained the boy's father and delayed an ambulance. The UN says at least 1,143 Palestinians, including 250 children, have been killed in the West Bank since October 2023. ACLED says 2026 is on track to be the worst year for settler violence in its decade of monitoring.
pts: Palestinian health ministry says Israel is withholding the boy's body
Military account and Palestinian account of the raid differ
Settler attacks described as at record levels
